clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
under the Ehiergency Relief Appropria­
tion Act of 1935 (49 Stat. 115, 118) and 
the act entitled “An Act to provide that 
funds allocated to Puerto Rico under the 
Emergency Relief Appropriation Act of 
1935 may be expended for permanent re­
habilitation, and for other purposes”, 
approved February 11, 1936 (49 Stat. 
1135), I  hereby appoint Edwin G. Ar­
nold, Director, Division of Territories 
and Island Possessions, Department of 
the Interior, as Administrator of the 
Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administra­
tion, vice Benjamin W. Thoron, resigned, 
to serve without additional compensa­
tion, and to exercise and discharge the 
functions, duties, and authority con­
ferred upon the Puerto Rico Reconstruc­
tion Administration and the Administra­
tor by Executive Orders No. 7057 of May 
28, 1935, No. 7180 of September 6, 1935, 
as amended by No. *7 5 5 4  of February 17, 
1937, and No. 7689 of August 12, 1937.
The said Executive orders are hereby 
amended accordingly.
